summary: All 18 registered pZT12 libraries match the authors’ sample sheet, nine per photoperiod. The authors estimated long versus short photoperiod across the circadian day using 121 mice. The public tables, code and labelled figures provide no pZT12-specific gene effect, so concordance remains unassessed. [Author analysis](https://gitlab.com/giannoma/OHC_RNAseq/-/blob/7de067c20fe5ed9d3c89e106212725ade85664de/analysis/DESeq2/DESeq2-Long-vs-Short.R)
openIssues: An author-produced pZT12 long-versus-short gene effect with identifiable libraries, baseline and batch handling would reopen the review.
The evidence folder is present in the workspace and verified against its manifest. This checkout’s Git exclude rules hide it from ordinary Git status.
